sections.heading: When to use
sections.text: Use full-bridge isolated converter for >200W applications. Four primary switches allow duty cycle > 0.5 and full bipolar excitation of the transformer. Vout = Vin*D/N. Most efficient use of the transformer at high power.

sections.heading: Controller structure
sections.text: Use current-mode control with peak or average sensing on the primary. For ZVS operation, use phase-shift control between the two legs (see PSFB). Without phase-shift, use conventional PWM with slope compensation.

sections.heading: Constraint
sections.text: Four switches increase cost and complexity. Ensure dead-time between complementary switches to prevent shoot-through. Current sensing on the primary requires a current transformer or sense resistor in the primary path.

sections.heading: Escalation trigger
sections.text: If efficiency is below target, consider phase-shift control (PSFB) for ZVS on primary switches. This reduces switching losses significantly at the cost of some duty-cycle loss.
